title: PHP 5.6.34 Released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 5.6.34. This is a security release. One security bug was fixed in this release. All PHP 5.6 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 5.6.34 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
